translations.english: At the time of moonrise, the darkness of dusk is dispelled, the dark deeds of cannibals disappear, the natural instinct for love returns to women as the radiance of the Moon spreads everywhere like in heaven.
translations.hindi: ससि तेज तम दुरि बढ्यो श्रामिढ-भखन रजनीचरन को । रमनी-प्रनय-कलहहिं दुराइ प्रदोस है सुखकरन को
